NEWBORN 2

6–12 weeks: faces, tracking and a first look at colour.

The second newborn class. Simple faces and patterns hold your baby’s attention a little longer, and slow side-to-side movement turns looking into early tracking.

Age 6–12 WeeksClass Newborn 2Subjects Visual tracking, faces, sound

Faces & Visual Tracking

Simple faces, gentle patterns and a first taste of colour, with slow side-to-side tracking. Two to five calm minutes at a time.
